scope: Offline review only; no Modal, GPU, remote-compute, or source-implementation mutation was performed.

v10_integrity_and_movement_facts.current_primitive: SHA-256 over the complete canonical payload plus SHA-256 per logical page
v10_integrity_and_movement_facts.current_atomicity: Fresh requests are detached from all scheduler queues, all pages are written and validated before group admission, and failure frees the entire restore incarnation group and resets the prefix cache.

integrity_design.reason: It matches the existing SLOForge transport policy, supports incremental hashing, and avoids weakening the v10 collision-resistance contract.
integrity_design.transport_compatibility: Keep the frozen v1 canonical payload and existing payload_sha256/content_sha256 meanings byte-for-byte. Add v11 streaming evidence outside the frozen v10 implementation path, or add only backward-compatible optional metadata within the same IR major version.
source_contract: Gather bytes in canonical page, layer, token, K/V, head, dimension order.
Update one aggregate SHA-256 and the owning logical-page SHA-256 as each bounded D2H chunk becomes host-visible.
Finalize each page only after its exact declared byte count is observed; reject gaps, overlaps, duplicates, reordered indices, short chunks, and trailing bytes.

Bind manifest identity, geometry, ordered page descriptors, ordered branch tables, token-history hashes, ancestry, policy epoch, chunk count, and chunk lengths into a separate canonical metadata SHA-256.
The transport is publishable only when streamed byte counts, page hashes, aggregate payload hash, metadata hash, and capture-plan coverage agree.
restore_contract: Validate metadata and runtime identity before allocating or exposing destination state.
Recompute the aggregate and page SHA-256 values while bounded host chunks are consumed for H2D, sharing that read with the restore stream rather than running a separate full-state verification pass.
Write only to fresh, detached native allocations under the exclusive engine-step gate.

Compute destination equality over the same logical canonical domain. A device SHA-256 implementation is acceptable only after independent parity tests against hashlib; otherwise use a bounded device-side exact byte comparison against the already-H2D canonical chunk, which is collision-free and transfers only the final pass/fail scalar to the host.
Compare all page results and the complete ordered coverage result before caching prefix blocks, updating computed-token watermarks, or enqueueing any restored request.

On mismatch, fail closed, persist mismatch metadata, recapture only for diagnosis, free every restore incarnation allocation, reset prefix-cache ownership, and do not report the optimized path successful.

includes: ordered logical page ID, logical token start, valid-token count, byte offset, and byte length
sorted logical page owners and shared/private classification
ordered logical branch ID, parent branch ID, computed-token boundary, logical page table, and token-history SHA-256
logical_hash_domain.separate_nonsemantic_evidence: Physical block IDs, GPU UUIDs, and allocation epochs remain mandatory provenance for freshness, ownership, source release, and anti-staleness checks, but cannot affect logical state equality.

integrity_proof_table.invariant: Canonical payload bytes are intact end to end
integrity_proof_table.other_existing_evidence: payload_sha256 plus content_sha256 for every logical page
integrity_proof_table.v11_shared_evidence: Incremental source hashes are finalized during the D2H stream; the same hashes are recomputed as chunks are consumed for H2D.
integrity_proof_table.remaining_required_work: One source stream hash and one restore-consumption stream hash; neither permits sampling.

integrity_proof_table.invariant: Restored native contents equal the logical transport state
integrity_proof_table.other_existing_evidence: Fresh allocation map and atomic detached-request staging
integrity_proof_table.v11_shared_evidence: Bounded native logical readback with device SHA-256 parity or exact device comparison against the H2D canonical chunk; return only digest/pass evidence unless mismatch diagnostics are required.
integrity_proof_table.remaining_required_work: A complete destination-native logical read and a complete comparison remain correctness-required; full D2H recapture, pageable expected-state concatenation, and host tensor comparison do not.

integrity_proof_table.invariant: Logical page coverage is complete, ordered, unique, and nonoverlapping
integrity_proof_table.other_existing_evidence: CanonicalKvTransportManifest validation, capture-plan coverage, exact destination map union, unique destination blocks, and exact byte cursor
integrity_proof_table.v11_shared_evidence: Strict chunk/page sequence machine plus canonical metadata SHA-256, checked before visibility
integrity_proof_table.remaining_required_work: Bounded metadata validation, set equality, byte-count equality, and final sequence closure.

integrity_proof_table.invariant: Model, tokenizer, policy epoch, dtype, and geometry match
integrity_proof_table.other_existing_evidence: Strict manifest model and validate_transport_identity plus validate_native_tensors
integrity_proof_table.v11_shared_evidence: Validate strict metadata and metadata SHA-256 before any native write.
integrity_proof_table.remaining_required_work: O(metadata) equality checks; no payload pass.

integrity_proof_table.invariant: Token history, computed-token boundary, branch ancestry, ownership, and shared-prefix semantics match
integrity_proof_table.other_existing_evidence: CanonicalBranchTable token_history_sha256, manifest branch/page cross-validation, and detached runtime request token comparison
integrity_proof_table.v11_shared_evidence: Bind ordered branch tables and owners into canonical metadata hash, then repeat runtime token/boundary checks before admission.
integrity_proof_table.remaining_required_work: O(metadata plus token history) checks; no KV payload pass beyond integrity.

integrity_proof_table.invariant: Destination allocations are fresh and no stale ownership becomes visible
integrity_proof_table.other_existing_evidence: Fresh runtime request IDs, allocation epochs, one-to-one destination map, detached scheduler state, and failure cleanup
integrity_proof_table.v11_shared_evidence: Retain allocation and ownership evidence unchanged; do not use logical hashes as a substitute.

integrity_proof_table.invariant: Captured source pages were completely released and cannot retain stale ownership
integrity_proof_table.other_existing_evidence: Exact captured block set, allocation epochs, released refcounts, cleared hashes, zero assigned KV bytes, unchanged warm pool reservation
integrity_proof_table.v11_shared_evidence: Retain exact source release proof unchanged.
integrity_proof_table.remaining_required_work: Bounded native metadata inspection after release.

integrity_proof_table.invariant: No partially restored state is visible
integrity_proof_table.other_existing_evidence: Exclusive engine-step gate, detached requests, validate-before-cache/enqueue, and group-wide cleanup
integrity_proof_table.v11_shared_evidence: Keep the same atomic staging order; streamed chunks must not cause early cache publication or request enqueue.
integrity_proof_table.remaining_required_work: Control-plane atomicity, not a full-state movement pass.

zero_fill_security_gate.full_pages: A separate zero pass may be removed only when the direct scatter deterministically overwrites every K/V byte of every layer before visibility.
zero_fill_security_gate.partial_final_pages: Zero at least the unread tail unless a version-specific vLLM kernel and scheduler proof establishes that no execution, hashing, cache publication, speculative path, or tenant transition can read it. The default is fail closed and retain tail zeroing.
zero_fill_security_gate.baseline_specific_observation: The measured 16,384-token prefix and 256-token private suffix align to the observed 1,024 shared and 128 private 16-token pages, so the measured state has no partial final KV page. This does not authorize removing tail handling from generalized fixtures.
zero_fill_security_gate.tenant_isolation: Fresh allocation alone is insufficient if any byte is left unreadably stale; either overwrite or zero every byte that can become runtime-visible.

review_run.locked_skip_reason: The local locked environment does not include torch, so test_vllm_reclamation_adapter.py was collection-skipped.

covered_by_v10_tests: Deterministic native-canonical-native round trip with a partial page and two native block-dimension placements.
One-bit transport corruption rejects the aggregate payload digest.
Missing or duplicate destination mappings are rejected.
Disjoint restore staging subsets are supported.
Validation failure frees pages and admits no request.
Cross-page destination aliasing frees the group.
Runtime identity and token-history mismatch fail before allocation.
Prefix state is never published before destination validation.
Partial admission failure removes the complete restore group.
Logical capture planning is invariant to physical source IDs and rejects divergent or partial-group sharing.
Exact source release requires cleared hashes, zero refcounts, and full pool recovery.
v11_gaps_before_micro_validation: The torch-backed vLLM reclamation adapter suite must also execute without skip in the exact locked or baked local-validation dependency image used to seal the pre-GPU gate; this review's 29-test execution used system torch 2.10.0.
No randomized/property suite yet covers page order, layer/block geometry, K/V content, chunk sizes, and shared/private splits.
No streamed hash implementation/parity test exists yet.
No negative test currently injects missing, duplicate, or reordered stream chunks.
No test corrupts destination native memory after direct scatter and before optimized validation.
No double-buffer event-lifetime/race test exists yet.
No v11 movement ledger test proves every removed pass disappeared without omitting a real read/write.
No explicit stale-tail tenant-isolation test exists for a v11 reduced-zero-fill path.

required_fail_closed_tests.requirement: Across explicit seeds, randomized page order, full and partial pages, layer counts, block counts, K/V axes, and shared/private splits, canonical transport payloads are bitwise equal and all v1 manifest semantic fields/hashes agree.
Logical native state is bitwise equal over every valid token and all required padding is deterministic.
Changing bounded chunk sizes and splitting a logical page across buffers does not change aggregate/page SHA-256 values or restored bytes.
Flip one bit in every representative location, including first/last byte and K/V/layer boundaries; validation rejects, publishes no request, frees all allocations, and emits mismatch evidence.
Each mutation fails sequence, count, range, page, or root validation before visibility.
Mutation fails strict manifest/metadata hashing even when payload bytes and payload_sha256 remain otherwise valid.
Each mismatch fails before destination native writes.
Corrupt one fresh destination page after write and before validation; native logical validation fails and no branch becomes schedulable.
Identical logical state in different physical block IDs/allocation epochs yields identical logical hashes while separate freshness evidence proves the allocations changed.
Seed stale nonzero destination bytes, restore a partial final page, and prove no stale readable byte remains under the selected zero/overwrite policy.
Delayed-copy fixtures prove a host or device chunk buffer is never reused before its producer/consumer completion event.
A device-side hash must match Python hashlib SHA-256 for empty, short, page-sized, multi-page, misaligned, and randomized payloads; there is no fallback to a weak checksum.
A naive full recapture may run only after the optimized verifier records failure; the attempt remains failed even if diagnostics locate the mismatch.
All eight branches produce at least eight continuation tokens and exactly match the first independently recomputed token.

causal_performance_methodology.diagnostic_trace_level: full only for one bounded state-pipeline diagnostic; never use its wall times as causal integrated results
causal_performance_methodology.profiler_overhead: Measure minimal-versus-full instrumentation overhead on a bounded representative pipeline inside the authorized micro-validation allocation. Preserve both raw samples and label the full-trace result diagnostic only.
timing_rules: Use monotonic wall time for externally visible milestones and process CPU time for host cost.
Use CUDA events around device operations and copies; defer event synchronization until a declared observation boundary and record every synchronization.
Record stream ID, event dependencies, bytes, copy sizes, and overlap for every operation.
Do not sum overlapping pass durations. Multiple StatePassRecords may share one CUDA operation; stage/chain time comes from the union of intervals in the pass DAG.
Count physical memory reads and writes once in full physical touch; report PCIe/NVLink transfer bytes separately and never add transfer-byte counters again to the physical-touch numerator.
Report critical-path movement only for passes whose intervals lie on the measured causal path, with explicit dependency edges.
Measure pinned, pageable, RSS, GPU temporary, and vLLM-pool peaks from allocation lifetimes rather than cumulative allocation bytes.
Keep engine/model warmup, runtime versions, model revision, GPU model/UUID/topology, driver, CUDA, seed, load, trigger, and branch geometry identical to v10 where causal comparison is claimed.
Run only the short 12-rps stable and 15-rps overload guards; do not spend budget on broad recalibration absent material drift.
Measure GPU0 completions, token rate, TTFT, CPU contention, and link traffic over the exact restore interval; a faster rollout path is not a win if production serving regresses materially.
causal_performance_methodology.adaptive_repetition: Start with one micro-validation. After an authorized valid integrated v11 and kill/recompute arm, add paired/randomized repetitions only if the architectural ordering is close or noisy; do not consume budget for cosmetic confidence.
causal_performance_methodology.frozen_v10_comparison: Do not rerun v10 when model/runtime and A100-SXM4/NVLink topology are sufficiently matched. If topology or driver materially differs, report the frozen comparison as noncausal or spend only the separately authorized minimal paired v10 run.

findings.finding: GPU execution is unauthorized and underfunded under the current configuration.
findings.required_action: Return BUDGET_BLOCKER and perform no Modal/GPU invocation until a new explicit v11 authorization and environment budget exist.

findings.finding: A hash-only destination validator would be a correctness regression if it omitted branch identity/ancestry or used physical block IDs as its domain.
findings.required_action: Use canonical logical bytes and separately bind strict identity/branch metadata; retain physical allocation evidence for freshness only.

findings.finding: Eliminating whole-page zeroing is unsafe for partial pages without a tail-read and tenant-isolation proof.
findings.required_action: Overwrite all full pages and zero partial tails by default; require an independent proof/test for any broader removal.

findings.finding: The v10 ledger has 270 segment records but 30 conceptual full-state passes; either number alone can be misleading.
findings.required_action: Report both record count and distinct complete-coverage pass count, and compute timing from interval unions rather than summed per-segment durations.
